Definition: from G746 and G5045; a chief constructor, i.e. "architect":--masterbuilder.
BiblicalUsage: The word is masterbuilder, a chief constructor, and it appears once, when Paul says that by the grace of God he has laid the foundation as a wise masterbuilder, and another builds on it.
TheologicalSignificance: A wise masterbuilder lays a foundation no one else can move, and Paul laid Christ.
